description: This file defines the RemoteTunnelManager actor, responsible for managing SSH tunnels for remote gateway/control port forwarding, including starting, stopping, and reusing tunnels, as well as handling restart logic with backoff.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: Swift actor managing SSH tunnels for remote control and gateway port forwarding, ensuring tunnel reuse, restart, and backoff logic.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if an SSH control tunnel is active and listening; if not, attempts to reuse existing tunnels or signals for restart.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures an SSH tunnel is established for the remote gateway control port, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Terminates the current SSH tunnel if it exists.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Determines if a process descriptor corresponds to an SSH process based on command or executable path.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates restart logic with backoff, preventing simultaneous restarts.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the end of a restart process and logs the completion.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Implements a backoff delay before attempting to restart, based on the last restart time.
